To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the expression of p73 N-terminally truncated isoforms is cell-type specific and their subcellular localization is different from the reference Daoy cells.
the protein isoforms of p73 have different subcellular localizations in medullobastoma cells.
the expression and sub-cellular localization of p73 isoform proteins in medulloblostoma cells is heterogeneous and differs between cells of different cell lines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of p73 in the development of medulloblastomas and other types of cancer.
the intracellular localization and distribution of two N terminal isoforms of the p73 tumor suppressor protein.
the intracellular localization and expression of p73 protein in medulloblostoma cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

p73 isoforms have a different subcellular localization in medullobastoma cells and that these changes are not only due to the different expression level of isoforms but also due to the different subcellular distribution.
the expression of p73 protein in medullob lastoma cells is highly heterogeneous, with a wide range of intracellular localizations.
TAp73 and the ∆Np63 and ∆N isoforms are localized in the nucleus, whereas ∆Np21 and ∆N are found in both the nucleus and cytoplasm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of p73 proteins in medulloblatoma is highly variable between different cell lines and the subcellular localization is also variable.
the intracellular localization and expression of p73 protein are cell type specific and are dependent on cell line, cell cycle and the presence of other proteins.
the expression of TAp73 and the ΔNp73 protein in medullobastoma cells is associated with the nuclear and cytoplasmic compartments, and that this localization is associated with cell proliferation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the subcellular localization of p73 isoform proteins in medullob lastoma cells is not random and is not identical for all cell lines.

TAp73 and its antagonistic ΔNp73 isoform are present in all cell lines analyzed, but there are differences in their intracellular distribution, which could be of importance for the function of these proteins in medullobastoma cells.
the subcellular localization of p73 isoform proteins is not random and may be a factor in the development of medulloblastomas.
